problem: A personal LinkedIn printer post was published after an earlier printer post, showing that text/story fingerprint gates were not sufficient to prevent reuse of the same concrete example.
root_cause: Uniqueness controls could still be interpreted around text/source fingerprints while a concrete story family could be regenerated or re-sourced with different wording.
prevention: Treat the underlying subject/example/story family as a permanently consumed unit after provider create.
Apply the rule across dates and social channels.
Never resolve a duplicate by paraphrasing; choose another verified source/topic.
User-reported duplicate feedback immediately retires that story family.
The printer story family is retired for personal LinkedIn.
